notes: Every os/arch/variant in releases.json was swept per major: first, middle and last release read, then bisected wherever two reads differed (about 1,000 binaries). Windows: node.exe fetched directly (win-<arch>/node.exe) and read for PE subsystem version, imports (vs the Windows version that introduced each API) and node.exe's own start-up refusal message ('This application is only supported on ...' in 6.0.0-14.4.x, 'Node.js is only supported on ...' with a NODE_SKIP_PLATFORM_CHECK=1 override from 14.5.0). The .msi LaunchCondition (VersionNT >= 601 for 6-13, >= 603 or Server 2012 for 14+) is never stricter than node.exe's own check. macOS: Mach-O minos per slice of bin/node. Linux: highest GLIBC_, GLIBCXX_ and CXXABI_ symbol version in bin/node (node links libstdc++ dynamically, so GLIBCXX can decide the floor), plus the kernel from the ELF ABI tag. Rules marked with a variant cover unofficial-builds.nodejs.org (unofficial, musl) or io.js (iojs). Versions between two reads with the same result inherit it.
